extDescription.message: Copies your YouTube Watch Later and X bookmarks into Clew, on this Mac.

pairHint.message: In Clew, open Settings › Browser and click Pair Chrome. Type the code here.

pairErrorCode.message: That code didn't work. Check it in Clew's Settings, or start pairing again there.

statusWaiting.message: Paired. Open your Watch Later page or your X bookmarks to import them.

statusTurnedOff.message: This list is turned off in Clew. Turn it on in Clew's Settings › General › Lists.

statusRevoked.message: Clew no longer knows this browser. Unpair, then pair again.

statusFailed.message: The last import didn't work. It will try again on your next visit.

statusNeedsUpdate.message: YouTube changed its page. Nothing was removed; this extension needs an update.

statusImported.message: Imported: $ADDED$ new. $LIST$ in Clew's Watch Later.

statusNeedsUpdateX.message: X changed its page. Nothing was removed; this extension needs an update.

statusImportedX.message: Imported: $ADDED$ new. $LIST$ in Clew's X bookmarks.
